name: maed-attendance
description: MAEd IT Integration: geo-fenced attendance ecosystem (Angular + Express + Prisma + MySQL).

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:push --prefix server && npm run db:seed --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm start --prefix client"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start --prefix server
